findings.fix: Use checked_add/checked_sub/checked_mul or the `checked` math pattern; anchor 0.29+ `#[access_control]` won't save you here.

findings.title: Token amount narrowed with an `as` cast, which truncates silently
findings.fix: Use `u64::try_from(x)?` / `x.try_into()?` so an out-of-range value errors instead of wrapping.

findings.title: unwrap()/expect() on account/instruction data - panic DoS
findings.fix: Use `try_from`/`Deref` with error propagation instead of unwrap on external input.
